name: bums.showdown.w4-b.name
authorNotes: Showdown / survive, 2-4 players, enclosed single-screen arena (no split-screen camera needed, §5) — the world's undercroft floods from below rather than the sea rising, but the mechanic is identical to W1's tide arena on purpose: it is already tuned to the §8.2 spec (a ~75s rise from base to summit) and reusing a validated shape halves the risk of a bad number here. All four spawn together on the base island; 'flood' is a crusher shaped as a rising wall, its path climbing from y1300 (below the island) to y150 (above the top perch) at 15.3px/s. Note for the engine ticket, same one w1-b already flagged: the Hazard contract has no time-varying shape/size field, only a static Shape plus a kinematic path, so 'closing boundary' is one large hazard translating upward rather than a true shrinking radius — not a new gap, the same one, flagged again because this level hits it too. Players retreat upward via swing-survive-mid then swing-survive-top as the flood climbs; the top perch holds only one comfortably. relic-w4-b sits on the top perch as a risk/reward pickup for the haul objective. A static void strip under the base island punishes anyone knocked off before the flood even arrives.
